posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
There is a new board game cafe in St. Louis called Pieces, and they have generously offered to let us use their space to run some preview adventures for the upcoming Sentinel Comics RPG! At these events, Christopher will run a 3ish hour adventure using the Sentinel Comics RPG system and pre-made characters. There will be room for up to 5 players per session. The current plan is for Christopher to run two events per day, one at 4pm and the other at 8pm, on Sunday, 26 February, and Sunday, 5 March.

My question for you all is, would any of you be interested in and able to attend any of those sessions? I know most people here don't live in St. Louis, but I wanted to check in with you all first before we publicize it in other ways.
